kitchen.title: Kitchen display
kitchen.description: Tickets by station, bump and recall acknowledged by the server.

common.noLocationsBody: Choose a scope with at least one location to use this screen.
common.readOnly: Your role can view this but not change it.

kds.title: Kitchen display
kds.description: Tickets routed to stations by item. Bump, recall and status changes wait for the server to confirm.
kds.staleTitle: Connection lost — this screen is not current
kds.staleBody: Last successful refresh at {time} ({ago}). Actions are paused until the connection returns.
kds.noStationsBody: Add stations (grill, cold, bar…) in Ordering settings to route items; until then every order shows on the expo view.
kds.emptyStation: Nothing for this station right now.
kds.allDone: All stations done — ready to hand over.

builder.title: Menu builder
builder.description: Categories, items, modifiers, business-supplied allergens and dietary labels, translations and day-parts. Publish with a preview and see the result at every location.
builder.readOnlyBody: Changing the master menu needs headquarters menu permissions.
builder.allergensDeclared: {n, plural, =0 {No allergens declared} one {# allergen declared} other {# allergens declared}}
builder.groups: {n, plural, one {# modifier group} other {# modifier groups}}
builder.prices: Prices by currency (leave empty if not sold in that currency)
builder.newItemHint: Add allergens, dietary labels, modifiers and translations after creating the item.
builder.name: Name
builder.allergensHint: Choose only what your business declares. Customers see them using each location's convention ({regimes}). BranchHarbor never infers allergens.
builder.declare: We declare allergens for this item
builder.allergensNotProvidedLong: Customers will see “Allergen information not provided — ask the restaurant”, never “none”.
builder.dayPartsHint: Empty = follows its category, then the menu. Evaluated in each location's local time.
builder.fallsBack: Falls back to the main name
builder.optionsHint: Comma separated; add a price with +, e.g. “Regular, Large +3”
builder.dayPartsBody: Windows use each location's local time, so breakfast in Seattle and London both end at 11:00 local.
builder.previewBody: What publishing does at each location before anything changes. Locations keep their permitted local prices and availability.

avail.title: Sold out & availability
avail.description: Mark items or single options sold out at a location. “Until close” resets automatically at closing time.

settings.title: Ordering settings
settings.description: Channels, tips, service charges, allergen convention, configured tax, delivery and kitchen stations per location.
settings.tax: Tax rate (%) set by your business
settings.taxHint: Leave empty to show no tax line. BranchHarbor never assumes a rate.
settings.serviceSummary: {pct} added for the selected channels, shown before payment.
settings.conventionHint: Which list customers see your declared allergens against.
settings.autoSoldOut: Sell out automatically when an ingredient runs out
settings.kdsSound: Kitchen audible alerts on by default
settings.noDeliveryHours: No delivery hours set — no delivery times are offered.
settings.stationsBody: Items route to the station matching their station key; anything else goes to the first station.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Zones with fees and minimums, drivers, and handoff to your own drivers or a delivery provider.
delivery.geocodingOffBody: Radius zones are checked when the customer shares their location; postcode zones always work.
delivery.noCoordinates: This location has no map coordinates, so use postcode zones (or add coordinates).
delivery.noZones: No zones yet — delivery is not offered.

tables.title: Tables & QR ordering
tables.description: Table codes for dine-in ordering. Guests pay at the table or add to the table's tab.
tables.qrHint: Print each link as a QR code on the table. Regenerating a code stops the old one working.
tables.regenConfirm: Generate a new code? The printed QR code will stop working.
tables.label: Table label

catering.title: Preorders & catering
catering.description: Catering enquiries are reviewed and quoted before acceptance and deposit. Cooking dates take preorders until their cut-off.
catering.dietaryNotesHint: check against your declared allergens before quoting
catering.quoteHint: The package price per guest is added automatically. Tax and service charge follow the location settings.
catering.datesBody: Customers pick the cooking date first; orders close at the cut-off (location time).
catering.aiBriefTitle: Prep brief (AI draft — numbers below are authoritative)
catering.prodCounts: {orders} orders · {events} catering events ({guests} guests) · {boxes} meal-plan boxes
catering.nothingToProduce: Nothing to produce for this date.

meal.title: Meal plans
meal.description: Weekly meal-prep boxes billed as subscriptions. Customers skip a week before its cut-off; boxes go to the kitchen on the day.
meal.releaseToday: Send today's boxes to the kitchen
meal.planRule: {meals} meals · {how} on {day} · changes close {days} days before at {time}

ing.title: Ingredients
ing.description: Stock per location in grams, millilitres or units. Orders deplete stock; items can sell out automatically when an ingredient runs out.
ing.nowSoldOut: {name} is now too low for one portion — items using it show as sold out.
ing.name: Name
ing.recipesHint: Quantity of each ingredient per portion. Set by headquarters.

reports.title: Food reports
reports.description: Orders by channel, prep times, sold-out frequency, revenue per currency, catering pipeline and meal plans.
reports.noSoldOut: Nothing sold out in this period.
